metadata.scope: This knowledge graph models mechanistic and microbiome-mediated pathways of Enterotoxigenic E. coli–associated diarrheal disease, integrating biological entities (organisms, genes, proteins, chemicals, diseases) with experimental and analytical context. The graph focuses on ETEC pathogenesis mechanisms, host-microbiome interactions, and metabolite-mediated modulation of disease outcomes.
